To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the business enterprise R & D expenditure has a significant impact on the transformation in manufacturing sector to the high technology specification in EU countries.
there is a causal relationship from business enterprise R&D expenditures to high technology specification in the manufacturing sector.
there is a long run relationship between R&D intensity and high technology specification of manufacturing sector in Europe.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between R&D expenditure and technological capability in manufacturing sector.
the role of business enterprise R&D in high tech specification of manufacturing sector in the European countries.
the importance of business enterprise R&D expenditure as a determinant of high tech production in Europe.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the business enterprise R&DEX is a main determinant for the transformation in the European manufacturing sector towards high technology specification.
the business enterprise R& D is a key driver of high tech production and productivity growth.
the business enterprise R&DEXP is one of the important sources of improving the technological capability of manufacturing sector in European countries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the business enterprise R &D expenditure is one of main sources for improving technological capability of high added value production.
the European countries should increase the business enterprise R & D intensity to achieve a high technology manufacturing sector.
the R&D intensity is a key factor to improve productivity growth and to increase competitiveness in manufacturing sector in Europe.
The main takeaway from our work is that
R&D expenditure is an essential factor for the development of high tech sectors and for the growth of European manufacturing sector.
the European countries have a long way to go in order to achieve the high tech production.
business enterprise R& D expenditure is a main driver for the high-tech specification of manufacturing sector.
